resources.string: Anti-Scroll combines Android usage history with a minimal accessibility service. Usage history remains the durable source; accessibility provides only a faster foreground signal for selected scrolling applications.
Anti-Scroll reads which supported application was in the foreground and when.
The accessibility service does not retrieve screen contents, visible text, messages, passwords, typed text, photos or accessibility nodes.
All observations and settings remain on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
Android allows Anti-Scroll to read usage history. The status is checked again whenever the application resumes.
Android requires this special access to reconstruct usage sessions. You remain in control and can revoke it at any time.
This device does not expose the expected usage-access service. Observation cannot start until Android provides it.
Anti-Scroll could not read the current system state. You can review the setting and return to try again.
Android could not open the requested settings screen on this device.
Android opens the main Accessibility screen. Open Downloaded apps (or Installed services), select Anti-Scroll monitoring, then enable the service. Usage history continues to work without it.
Android reports the service enabled and connected. It emits transient package-level foreground signals without reading window contents.
Android reports the service enabled but not connected. Open Downloaded apps (or Installed services), select Anti-Scroll monitoring, disable and enable it again, then return to Anti-Scroll.
This device does not expose the expected accessibility service manager. Real-time foreground detection is unavailable.
Anti-Scroll could not read the accessibility-service state. Open Downloaded apps (or Installed services), select Anti-Scroll monitoring, then return to try again.
No monitored applications yet. Open the Apps tab to choose what Anti-Scroll should observe.
Anti-Scroll could not read the latest local statistics. Try refreshing the observation.
Use a monitored application, then return to Anti-Scroll to generate the first statistics.
Android usage history is being collected and reconciled normally.
Anti-Scroll found an incomplete observation period and will retry automatically.
Usage access or the Android usage-history source is currently unavailable.
Choose at least one monitored application to start learning your habits.
Only completed days with reliable data count. Partial days are skipped instead of distorting your future limits.
Select the installed scrolling applications Anti-Scroll should observe. Your choices are stored only on this device.
No supported scrolling applications are currently installed on this device.
Anti-Scroll could not read the supported applications installed on this device.
The latest selection could not be saved. The previous configuration was restored.
